name: B4·1 E-commerce Orders — order intake + stock decrement + thank-you + delivery tracking (4 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. Attach Telegram + Google Sheets credentials. Variables: TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID, BRAND_NAME. Replace REPLACE_SHEET_ID.
2. Tabs: **Orders** (OrderID, Date, Customer, Phone, Item, Qty, Amount, Payment, ShipStatus, AWB) and **Stock** (as in B3·1).
3. **Order intake webhook** (`order-in`): point your store here —
   • Shopify: Settings → Notifications → Webhooks → 'Order creation' → paste Production URL (JSON).
   • Own site/WhatsApp orders: POST {customer, phone, item, qty, amount, payment}.
4. **Shipping updates webhook** (`ship-update`): paste in your courier panel (Shiprocket/Sequel: Settings → Webhooks) — fires on status change.

## HOW IT RUNS
• Order in → logged to Orders + stock Qty reduced + owner Telegram alert + customer thank-you (wa.me link, one tap).
• COD order → flagged ⚠ for manual verify call.
• Courier status change → Orders.ShipStatus updated + customer update text drafted.

## 🔧 FIX
• Shopify payload different → adjust field mapping in 'Normalise order' (it already tries Shopify + generic shapes).
• Stock not reducing → Item names must match Stock.Item exactly.
